cn.description:
这是一款关于生、死、心愿与延续的App。

小时候，我以为自己是不会老去的彼得·潘，却终究敌不过健康磨损，容颜老去。
时针转动，生命流逝，但每一次心跳都可以更加有力。

有时候，生命只是一连串的数字，多少年，多少月，多少小时，多少分钟。当你意识到这个时，往往陷入巨大的虚无感之中，惶恐不能自拔。
而现在，这些数字可以成为你重塑生命的坐标，指引你走向更健康、更长久的未来。

生辰 2.0 通过 AI 分析和科学判断，不仅预测生命的终点，更为你铺就延长生命的道路：

- 探索你的生命时钟：了解当下的预期寿命，直面生命的有限与珍贵。
- 发现延寿的可能：看见改变健康习惯能为你带来多少额外的生命时光。
- 聚合健康数据：自动追踪睡眠、锻炼、压力（HRV）、经期、喝水等十余种健康数据

美国诗人纳·斯待尔在87岁那年写道：
"如果我能够从头活过，我会试着犯更多的错。
我会放松一点，我会灵活一点。
我会爬更多的山，游更多的河，看更多的日落。"

因为了解生命的终点，才能更好地珍惜当下的每一刻。生辰2.0 探索健康的可能，让我们成为你健康旅程的长久伙伴。

重要提示:
[1]. RPGEmu支持大约90%的RPG Maker MV/MZ游戏，50%的RPG Maker XP/VXAce/VX 游戏。
[2]. 如果您买这个模拟器仅仅想玩RPG Maker XP/VXAce/VX游戏，那么请考虑到您想玩的游戏可能无法在RPGEmu上运行，最好是先发邮件问下您的游戏到底能不能在RPGEmu上玩。当然，如果您能接受RPGEmu的价格玩MV/MZ类型的游戏，那么放心购买吧，RPGEmu对MV/MZ游戏的广泛支持不会令您失望。
[3]. 因此，您如果仅仅是RPG Maker XP/VXAce/VX游戏迷，这个APP也许并不适合您，因为只有50%的游戏可玩。
[4]. RPGEmu擅长RPG Maker MV/MZ游戏，然而对于RPG Maker XP/VXAce/VX游戏，它仅仅能玩部分游戏。
[5]. 永远不要期望RPGEmu能玩所有的游戏，即使游戏是由RPG Maker MV/MZ/XP工具创建的。
[6]. 剩下的10%或者50%可能正是您想玩的，我们希望您在买RPGEmu之前对此已经知悉。
[7]. 您可以通过邮件联系我们: allen.gzqyl@gmail.com，我们将会尽力助您解决问题。
[8]. 如果您很担心是否可以玩“...某个游戏", 您应该如何做？(a). 给我们发邮件，我们将会帮您确认这个游戏是否能玩，仅在确认能玩后再买RPGEmu. (b). 干脆不买RPGEmu也是可以的。
[9]. 如果您手上没有RPG Maker MV/MZ/XP游戏资源，或者说不知道从何处下载这些资源，Safari下载的资源将会处于[文件]APP的下载里面，可以直接导入到RPGEmu，如果您完全不知如何获取资源，手上也没有资源，那么不要安装RPGEmu，因为这个APP是一个空壳工具，仅仅自带了3个极其简单的示例游戏，可用于功能测试，但无可玩性。您需要有自己的资源，RPGEmu将助您畅玩那些游戏资源。

为什么选择RPGEmu呢?
1.SwiftUI设计，玩或者不玩RPG Maker游戏变得非常简单
2.支持直接导入MV/MZ/XP Windows游戏包，无需电脑，即可在手机上畅玩那些游戏
3.虚拟键盘的设计，让操控游戏角色变得更简单

注意:
在导入游戏包的时候，千万不要切出应用，必须耐心等待文件传输完成，否则，传输一旦被意外中断，您将需要重新开始传输。
对于大文件游戏包，最好将其事先置入[文件]APP，这样传输起来更稳定，U盘方式我们测试发现，可能由于接触不稳定，部分文件在传输中丢失了，导致游戏报错。
大约预留3倍于游戏包大小的可用磁盘空间，不然传输可能无法完成，即使完成，也可能因空间不够，造成部分文件未传。

应用内置了3个示例游戏，仅用于功能测试，无可玩性。获取此类游戏资源其实非常简单，很多都是可免费获取的，仅我们测试的MV/MZ就有多于100个免费的，当然，我们也测试了近30个XP/VXAce/VX游戏。

为什么RPGEmu只能玩一半XP/VXAce/VX游戏呢？因为RPGEmu是基于Ruby 3创建的，然后很多旧游戏是Ruby 1.8/1.9写的，这样，RPGEmu就会尝试应用补丁，尽管补丁解决了一大部分旧游戏，但仍然无法解决部分游戏。另外，某些游戏与Windows绑定过深，极难在iOS上还原那些DLL，尽管RPGEmu已经模拟了大部分DLL，对于少数游戏，还是无法解决。对此，我们深感抱歉，也期望您能理解。

RPGEmu给了您在手机上玩那些由RPG Maker MV/MZ/XP制作工具创建的游戏的机会。
尽管RPGEmu不提供任何游戏，获取"RPG Maker MV/MZ/XP 游戏"却并非难事。

也许您在电脑上已经有了大量的此类游戏，如果是这样的，将它们转移到手机上的[文件]APP，然后就可以用RPGEmu导入开玩了。

如果游戏是由RPG Maker MV工具创建的，我们称之为RPG Maker MV游戏，简称[MV Game]。
如果游戏是由RPG Maker MZ工具创建的，我们称之为RPG Maker MZ游戏，简称[MZ Game]。
如果游戏是由RPG Maker XP/VXAce/VX工具创建的，我们称之为RPG Maker XP游戏，简称[XP Game]。

一旦您安装了RPGEmu，您将可以在手机上玩那些Windows [MV Game] / [MZ Game] / [XP Game]类型的游戏包。

FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

cn.description:
【游戏特色】
坐落于神秘远星的枪牢森严诡谲，无数枪怪弹魔徘徊在地下深处——传说中可以抹去过去的神枪亦藏匿于此。射击，劫掠，翻滚躲闪，背负痛苦回忆的探险者孤注一掷，突进层层膛室，在枪林弹雨中寻找能够翻转命运的终极宝藏……
▶ 原汁原味的枪弹地狱
狱室迷宫随机错布，每一层都充斥着穷凶极恶的枪支炮灰，终极恶魔各自布下奇诡的枪火弹网。选择不同背景的英雄角色，穿越重重膛室和机关陷阱探索神枪残迹。
▶ 天马行空的神枪宝藏
变蛇激光、豌豆射手、彩虹、蜜蜂——没错，蜜蜂！每把枪里射出的都是未知，亦能和掉落道具组合出1+1>2。探险者的背包不设上限，各类彩蛋奇宝都在地牢深处等待发掘。
▶ 枪打子弹？子弹打枪？
所有人都是枪的忠实信徒，一切都和枪弹有关！弹壳货币、子弹小怪、扳机兄弟……在地牢里，你甚至可以扮演一个用子弹枪发射枪子弹的子弹人！

【针对手游的设计优化】
▶ 打不过？就「滚弹」！
面对密集的子弹壁垒，使用“无敌”翻滚灵活闪避！切换多种翻滚模式，选择自动、手动或半辅助瞄准射击，自定义调整按键布局，我们希望为玩家提供最适配手游的操作应对地牢难关！
▶ 双人协作，联机闯关
我们专门为移动端开发了线上联机双人模式。在联机大厅创建/加入房间，或是通过好友系统邀请伙伴，自由选择角色并肩作战！
---------------------------

cn.description:
《手机帝国》是一款以“造手机”为题材的高自由度单机模拟经营游戏。你扮演一名回到2001年的创业者，因为独到的眼光拿到了神秘投资人的启动资金，进而创立了一家可能改变世界的科技企业。游戏从2001年开始到2035年结束，你将从研发最早期的九宫格智能手机开始，一直到研发可完全独立使用的AR智能眼镜结束。在这35年时间里，你将亲历、见证、推动智能手机波澜壮阔的发展历程，并有机会把你的公司发展成为世界第一的科技企业。

•有深度的玩法
《手机帝国》的核心玩法是研发更好的图纸、升级更牛的科技、打造更强的团队、研发更好的手机、赚取更多的利润，如此循环。而“如何用人”是整个游戏的精髓所在，根据员工的能力、天赋和技能，把合适的员工放到合适的岗位才会发挥出其最大潜能。员工的配合还会触发团队突破效果，这是一个可以让你突破科技限制从而创造奇迹的新机制。

•海量的内容
你在游戏中可研发经典的九宫格手机、全键盘手机、早期触控手机、全面屏手机、折叠屏手机，甚至未来的AR智能眼镜，总共有超过100种手机外观供你研究。

•不断进阶的科技
游戏中的电池、屏幕、材质、相机等均可不断升级，在你资金充裕时甚至可以启动CPU和操作系统的自研项目，你将有可能研发出性能逆天的芯片来大幅提升自己的手机品质。

•新颖的竞争体验
你作为科技公司的CEO将与各个时期的科技巨头们展开竞争，你可以选择和他们搞好关系共谋发展，也可以为争夺优秀人才展开挖人大战。

•大量的随机事件
为了增加游戏的世界感，我们在游戏中融入了大量的随机事件，包括：世界事件、行业新闻、危机事件、幸运事件、员工事件、记者采访等等，甚至还包括比如太空电梯、火星登陆、AI大爆发等未来事件。

•独创的说服系统
为了更好的模拟现实生活中的人才招揽过程，我们在游戏中内置了一款小游戏，该游戏以古老的“九型人格”为原型，玩家需要根据招募对象的不同人格类型，采用不同的沟通技巧和策略来说服对方。越是顶级的人才，说服的难度越高。

•更多等待你探索的内容
游戏中还包括信用评级、企业并购、情报系统、员工培养、公司战略等其他好玩的元素等待你来探索。

[游戏说明]

由幻刃网络研发，心动网络发行的《ICEY》是一款2D横版动作游戏，跟随旁白的指示，你将会通过ICEY的眼睛去看，去战斗并发掘在游戏中世界的真相。但其实，这也根本不是一款2D横版动作游戏，你也不会通过ICEY的眼睛去看，你也不会去探寻这个世界的真相。

本质上说《ICEY》是一款Meta游戏，玩家需要通过对抗旁白的指示，思考何为游戏、何为真相等等命题。在《ICEY》中，你扮演的是ICEY，而非“你自己”。当然你也可以扮演“你自己”，而非ICEY。这是一个包裹着动作游戏外衣的陷阱。

现在，就是你发掘其真正故事的时刻。

[游戏特色]

·高速战斗： 高速移动，将敌人玩弄于股掌之中。 不能迟疑，当机立断进行攻击、反击或是闪避！ 这才是你的生存之道！ 

·华丽的连招系统： 操作简单，稍微练习即可打出华丽连击。 不同技能各有特性，灵活组合才能顺利过关。 

·巨型Boss战： 众多超巨型Boss，充满压迫力的战斗场面。 Boss攻击方法多样，只有找出破绽才能化险为夷。 

·Meta元素： 玩家在整个游戏进行中需结合旁白判断自己下一步的行动。 但是，通过对碎片信息的分析及整理，玩家会渐渐改变自己的行为及思考模式去进行游戏并探索其中真正的剧情及核心内容。 跟随指引，还是叛逆而为。

一切，由你决定。你，准备好了吗？

《笼中窥梦》是一款「视错觉」解谜游戏，由两人工作室Optillusion开发完成。

游戏的内容全部包含在一个神秘的立方体中，立方体的每个面都是一个独立的世界：工厂，灯塔，游乐园，教堂等等，他们之间看似毫不相关，实则交错万千，充满了意想不到的关联……

【烧脑视错觉解谜】
发挥你的脑洞与想象力，找到那些平凡场景与物体之间的联系，产生意想不到的奇妙互动，拼接，然后见证奇迹诞生。

游戏包含多种解谜引导机制，包括最基础的「视觉引导」，帮助你快速定位关键物品；而「文字提示」则可以帮你整理解谜思路；最后还有「视频提示」，用终极手段保证你绝不会卡关。

【拿下奖章证明实力】
游戏拥有 15 个成就，每个成就都对应着一个根据剧情设计的独特奖章。如果你是解谜游戏达人，那就用这些奖章来证明自己吧~

hk.description:
FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

《手機帝國》是一款以“造手機”為題材的高自由度單機模擬經營遊戲。你扮演一名回到2001年的創業者，因為獨到的眼光拿到了神秘投資人的啟動資金，進而創立了一家可能改變世界的科技企業。遊戲從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將從研發最早期的九宮格智能手機開始，一直到研發可完全獨立使用的AR智能眼鏡結束。在這35年時間裡，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程，並有機會把你的公司發展成為世界第一的科技企業。

• 有深度的玩法
《手機帝國》的核心玩法是研發更好的圖紙、升級更牛的科技、打造更強的團隊、研發更好的手機、賺取更多的利潤，如此循環。而“如何用人”是整個遊戲的精髓所在，根據員工的能力、天賦和技能，把合適的員工放到合適的崗位才會發揮出其最大潛能。員工的配合還會觸發團隊突破效果，這是一個可以讓你突破科技限制從而創造奇蹟的新機制。

• 充足的遊戲時長
《手機帝國》的遊戲內時間長達35年，將從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程。

• 海量的內容
你在遊戲中可研發經典的九宮格手機、全鍵盤手機、早期觸控手機、全面屏手機、折疊屏手機，甚至未來的AR智能眼鏡，總共有超過100種手機外觀供你研究。

• 不斷進階的科技
遊戲中的電池、屏幕、材質、相機等均可不斷升級，在你資金充裕時甚至可以啟動CPU和操作系統的自研項目，你將有可能研發出性能逆天的芯片來大幅提升自己的手機品質。

• 新穎的競爭體驗
你作為科技公司的CEO將與各個時期的科技巨頭們展開競爭，你可以選擇和他們搞好關係共謀發展，也可以為爭奪優秀人才展開挖人大戰。

• 大量的隨機事件
為了增加遊戲的世界感，我們在遊戲中融入了大量的隨機事件，包括：世界事件、行業新聞、危機事件、幸運事件、員工事件、記者採訪等等，甚至還包括比如太空電梯、火星登陸、 AI大爆發等未來事件。

• 獨創的說服系統
為了更好的模擬現實生活中的人才招攬過程，我們在遊戲中內置了一款小遊戲，該遊戲以古老的“九型人格”為原型，玩家需要根據招募對象的不同人格類型，採用不同的溝通技巧和策略來說服對方。越是頂級的人才，說服的難度越高。

• 更多等待你探索的內容
遊戲中還包括信用評級、企業併購、情報系統、員工培養、公司戰略等其他好玩的元素等待你來探索。

hk.description:
[遊戲說明]

由幻刃網絡研發，心動網絡發行的《ICEY》是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，跟隨旁白的指示，你將會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，去戰鬥並發掘在遊戲中世界的真相。但其實，這也根本不是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，你也不會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，你也不會去探尋這個世界的真相。

本質上說《ICEY》是一款Meta遊戲，玩家需要通過對抗旁白的指示，思考何爲遊戲、何爲真相等等命題。在《ICEY》中，你扮演的是ICEY，而非“你自己”。當然你也可以扮演“你自己”，而非ICEY。這是一個包裹著動作遊戲外衣的陷阱。

現在，就是你發掘其真正故事的時刻。

[遊戲特色]

·高速戰鬥： 高速移動，將敵人玩弄于股掌之中。 不能遲疑，當機立斷進行攻擊、反擊或是閃避！ 這才是你的生存之道！ 

·華麗的連招系統： 操作簡單，稍微練習即可打出華麗連擊。 不同技能各有特性，靈活組合才能順利過關。 

·巨型Boss戰： 衆多超巨型Boss，充滿壓迫力的戰鬥場面。 Boss攻擊方法多樣，只有找出破綻才能化險爲夷。 

·Meta元素： 玩家在整個遊戲進行中需結合旁白判斷自己下一步的行動。 但是，通過對碎片信息的分析及整理，玩家會漸漸改變自己的行爲及思考模式去進行遊戲並探索其中真正的劇情及核心內容。 跟隨指引，還是叛逆而爲。

一切，由你決定。你，准備好了嗎？

hk.description:
《籠中窺夢》是一款「視錯覺」解謎遊戲，由兩人工作室Optillusion開發完成。

遊戲的內容全部包含在一個神秘的立方體中，立方體的每個面都是一個獨立的世界：工廠，燈塔，遊樂園，教堂等等，他們之間看似毫不相關，實則交錯萬千，充滿了意想不到的關聯……

【燒腦視錯覺解謎】
發揮你的腦洞與想象力，找到那些平凡場景與物體之間的聯系，產生意想不到的奇妙互動，拼接，然後見證奇跡誕生。

【收集照片拼湊故事】
謎題背後，遊戲還有一個等待著被玩家們發現並反轉的故事。通過收集照片拼湊故事，試著解開它隱藏的真相吧。

【多重提示杜絕卡關】
遊戲包含多種解謎引導機製，包括最基礎的「視覺引導」，幫助你快速定位關鍵物品；而「文字提示」則可以幫你整理解謎思路；最後還有「視頻提示」，用終極手段保證你絕不會卡關。

【拿下獎章證明實力】
遊戲擁有 15 個成就，每個成就都對應著一個根據劇情設計的獨特獎章。如果你是解謎遊戲達人，那就用這些獎章來證明自己吧~

hk.description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.
Sometimes, the right choice is not to follow the rules.
Sometimes, the only right choice is the rules.

Consequences of Your Decisions

Watch the impact of your decisions in the journalist’s broadcast at the end of each day.
Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

Trusted by over 500,000 families. The original, best-in-class baby heart sounds app to hear baby beat at home with your iPhone. Hear My Baby uses your iPhone microphone to help you listen to baby heart sounds. HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. 

Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App

- Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required
- AI chat support provides step-by-step help with setup, positioning and recording conditions 
- Enhances low-frequency audio captured by the iPhone microphone to help users listen for and save special pregnancy sounds.
- Tailored tutorial adapts to your stage of pregnancy and setup
- Create baby sex reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to share the moment
- Record & save clips; build a personal timeline you can revisit
- Share easily with family and friends (Instagram, WhatsApp, email)
- Designed by parents with expertise in sound engineering, AI and app development; warm, honest guidance throughout
- Privacy first — you control what’s saved and shared

Real 5 Star Reviews

"I never leave reviews, let along pay for apps but let’s just say I tried this , and it def works" - Lov3r_Gurl IG (USA Sept 2025)
“I always find 'it' (sic) eventually and the rhythm is clear and strong. I love that I can record them to keep.” - T Lucker (Australia 2025)
"I downloaded this very skeptical... It took me about 45 minutes of laying down, very still, with noise canceling headphones on, but I HEARD IT. I am almost 18 weeks pregnant. From one momma to the next, it’s worth it." - Baby'sHeartbeat (2025)

“It took some time and patience... thank you for creating this cheap, awesome technology to use at home.” — Niki
“I was skeptical at first. Great app! Worth it.” — Legretta

How it works
- Hear My Baby uses your iPhone’s microphone to listen for abdominal sounds; it is not a doppler and doesn’t emit ultrasound. It’s a lifestyle keepsake for bonding and sharing, not a medical device and not for diagnosis.
- Our advanced audio engine isolates and amplifies fetal heartbeat sounds so you can listen and save the recording, and trim it to the appropriate moment for sharing quickly and easily.
- Best from around 16+ weeks; clearest for many families at ~27 weeks. Results vary with baby’s position and placenta location.

Tips for best results
- Be still, breathe lightly, and try several positions around your bump
- Press the mic firmly against the skin; explore low and to the sides
- Bluetooth/over-ear headphones can make subtle sounds easier to hear

Important
Hear My Baby is not a medical device and doesn’t replace prenatal care. If you’re concerned about anything in your pregnancy, please consult your clinician. Seek a doctor’s advice if you have any concerns. You can switch to Airplane Mode while using the app.

hk.description:
《Way of the Hunter》將推出手機端系列首作，太平洋西北地區的壯美景觀隨之鋪陳眼前。

在美國內茲珀斯谷的廣闊開放世界中，體驗最真實的狩獵與探索。在风景如画的自然栖息地中发现栩栩如生的动物，使用各种细节逼真的武器。

《獵人征途》的野生動物外型真實而美麗，且具備符合現實的動物群體行為特徵，提供玩家全面且真實的狩獵體驗，讓人能完全沉浸在遊戲世界。親眼目睹複雜多樣的生態環境產生的變化，周遭環境會因為你的行動而出現變動及反應。瞭解真正的獵人所代表的意義，並充分運用自己的技能來戰勝考驗。

面對人道狩獵的挑戰、搭配引人入勝的故事情節進行遊戲，或是單純地在這富饒的自然環境中自由狩獵。

* 數十種細節精緻的動物物種與真實的行為模式，為你帶來真正身歷其境的狩獵體驗
* 醒目標示動物跡象、血跡分析，以及能夠倒回觀看子彈鏡頭的射擊回顧畫面，這些功能都能讓您像專業獵人一樣狩獵
* 使用獵人感官將重要詳情和資訊醒目標示出來，或者關閉獵人感官，讓遊戲體驗更具挑戰性

* 細膩又自然的動物動作，以及動物察覺到玩家存在時的真實反應
* 24 小時的日夜循環，再加上風和天氣的變化
* 真實彈道與子彈物理模擬
* 大量槍枝和裝備選擇，其中包含證照管制裝備，例如：Bushnell、Federal、Leupold、Primos、Remington 和 Steyr Arms

* 優化手機端操控，兼顧舒適與效率

你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

率領銀河各地最勇猛的戰鬥部隊。與聯邦最強大的海軍陸戰隊並肩作戰！

hk.description:
加入数百万玩家，开启这款怪物训练游戏的续集冒险之旅！
在《EvoCreo 2》中，进入充满神秘的怪物世界，捕捉、培养并进化超过300种怪物。体验一个开放世界的RPG，展开一场充满怪物战斗与冒险的游戏旅程。怪物的进化和捕捉是你在这个怪物游戏中的使命，而这片土地上神秘的怪物，等待着你的探索！

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界
在《EvoCreo 2》里，你可以享受超过30小时的离线与在线RPG玩法，探索这个充满怪物和隐藏秘密的开放世界。从茂密的森林到神秘的洞穴，再到繁华的城镇，Shoru大陆充满了待解的谜题。在冒险的过程中，挑战不同的怪物，完成任务，解锁隐藏的路径和传奇的宝藏。

掌握深度且策略性的战斗系统
准备好迎接训练师之间的激烈战斗了吗？在这个高度可定制化的RPG游戏中，你可以装备你的怪物，并解锁100多种独特特征来增强它们的能力。训练你的怪物，学习并掌握超过200种技能，随时根据战斗的需要调整技能。通过怪物战斗，管理元素弱点，运用策略技能，成为真正的怪物训练大师！

证明自己，成为终极怪物训练大师
挑战Shoru的最强怪物训练师，在这个付费RPG游戏中崭露头角！参加声名显赫的竞技场，只有最强的怪物训练师才能获得冠军称号。你能在怪物战斗中获得胜利，登上冠军宝座，成为最顶尖的怪物训练大师吗？

主要特点：
- 世界顶级付费角色扮演游戏的续集
- 捕捉、培养、进化超过300只怪物
- 没有怪物等级上限，充满挑战的游戏结局！
- 拓展的开放世界，30小时以上的离线与在线RPG玩法
- 引人入胜的回合制怪物战斗，深度策略元素
- 数百种技能和特征，自由定制你的怪物
- 超过50个充满冒险和奖励的任务
- 离线模式——无需互联网也能畅玩游戏
- 精美的像素艺术，回归经典怪物RPG风格

玩家为何喜爱《EvoCreo 2》：
《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合
休闲和硬核玩家都能享受这款充满冒险和动作的怪物游戏
今天就加入我们的冒险，开始成为终极怪物训练大师的旅程吧！你能捕捉所有怪物，解开Creo的秘密吗？

hk.description:
《展翅翱翔》是一款屢獲殊榮的鳥類主題策略卡牌遊戲，也是一部鮮活的交互式鳥類百科，清新有趣，輕鬆愉快，適合1-5名玩家。作為鳥類發燒友，你的目標是發現和吸引更多的鳥兒加入你的自然保護區。

《展翅翱翔》（Wingspan）官方授權電子版改編，曾榮獲2019年德國年度桌面遊戲獎，權威桌遊網站BBG家庭類桌遊位列世界第一。

你們是一群鳥類發燒友——研究員、鳥類觀察家、鳥類學家和收藏家——你們一直在尋覓並試圖吸引那些最美麗的鳥類棲息到自己的野生動物保護區來。每一種鳥的加入都會讓你其中一塊棲息地上的鳥類組合變得更為豐富多彩。每一塊棲息地都各自專注於保護區生態搭建的某一重要方面。

本遊戲中，1-5名玩家在有限的回合內構建他們的自然保護區，並與其他玩家競爭。每當新的鳥類加入自然保護區，都會提升保護區在某個方面的能力，諸如鳥類產蛋、抽取新的鳥類卡牌或者收集食物。遊戲中包含170種獨特的鳥類，它們各自擁有對應它們在自然世界中所有的專長或者偏好的技能：例如，老鷹會捕獵，鵜鶘會捕魚，白鵝喜歡群居。

遊戲特色
* 輕鬆愉快的策略類卡牌遊戲，你的目標是發現和吸引最好的鳥兒。
* 同時支持單人和多人模式，最多可5名玩家組隊暢玩。
* 基於屢獲殊榮的引擎構築桌面遊戲，以卡牌為驅動，富有競爭樂趣。
* 數百隻獨特的鳥兒，配有動畫畫面和真實錄音。
* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

mo.description:
FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

mo.description:
《手機帝國》是一款以“造手機”為題材的高自由度單機模擬經營遊戲。你扮演一名回到2001年的創業者，因為獨到的眼光拿到了神秘投資人的啟動資金，進而創立了一家可能改變世界的科技企業。遊戲從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將從研發最早期的九宮格智能手機開始，一直到研發可完全獨立使用的AR智能眼鏡結束。在這35年時間裡，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程，並有機會把你的公司發展成為世界第一的科技企業。

• 有深度的玩法
《手機帝國》的核心玩法是研發更好的圖紙、升級更牛的科技、打造更強的團隊、研發更好的手機、賺取更多的利潤，如此循環。而“如何用人”是整個遊戲的精髓所在，根據員工的能力、天賦和技能，把合適的員工放到合適的崗位才會發揮出其最大潛能。員工的配合還會觸發團隊突破效果，這是一個可以讓你突破科技限制從而創造奇蹟的新機制。

• 充足的遊戲時長
《手機帝國》的遊戲內時間長達35年，將從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程。

• 海量的內容
你在遊戲中可研發經典的九宮格手機、全鍵盤手機、早期觸控手機、全面屏手機、折疊屏手機，甚至未來的AR智能眼鏡，總共有超過100種手機外觀供你研究。

• 不斷進階的科技
遊戲中的電池、屏幕、材質、相機等均可不斷升級，在你資金充裕時甚至可以啟動CPU和操作系統的自研項目，你將有可能研發出性能逆天的芯片來大幅提升自己的手機品質。

• 新穎的競爭體驗
你作為科技公司的CEO將與各個時期的科技巨頭們展開競爭，你可以選擇和他們搞好關係共謀發展，也可以為爭奪優秀人才展開挖人大戰。

• 大量的隨機事件
為了增加遊戲的世界感，我們在遊戲中融入了大量的隨機事件，包括：世界事件、行業新聞、危機事件、幸運事件、員工事件、記者採訪等等，甚至還包括比如太空電梯、火星登陸、 AI大爆發等未來事件。

• 獨創的說服系統
為了更好的模擬現實生活中的人才招攬過程，我們在遊戲中內置了一款小遊戲，該遊戲以古老的“九型人格”為原型，玩家需要根據招募對象的不同人格類型，採用不同的溝通技巧和策略來說服對方。越是頂級的人才，說服的難度越高。

• 更多等待你探索的內容
遊戲中還包括信用評級、企業併購、情報系統、員工培養、公司戰略等其他好玩的元素等待你來探索。

[遊戲說明]

由幻刃網絡研發，心動網絡發行的《ICEY》是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，跟隨旁白的指示，你將會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，去戰鬥並發掘在遊戲中世界的真相。但其實，這也根本不是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，你也不會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，你也不會去探尋這個世界的真相。

本質上說《ICEY》是一款Meta遊戲，玩家需要通過對抗旁白的指示，思考何爲遊戲、何爲真相等等命題。在《ICEY》中，你扮演的是ICEY，而非“你自己”。當然你也可以扮演“你自己”，而非ICEY。這是一個包裹著動作遊戲外衣的陷阱。

現在，就是你發掘其真正故事的時刻。

[遊戲特色]

·高速戰鬥： 高速移動，將敵人玩弄于股掌之中。 不能遲疑，當機立斷進行攻擊、反擊或是閃避！ 這才是你的生存之道！ 

·華麗的連招系統： 操作簡單，稍微練習即可打出華麗連擊。 不同技能各有特性，靈活組合才能順利過關。 

·巨型Boss戰： 衆多超巨型Boss，充滿壓迫力的戰鬥場面。 Boss攻擊方法多樣，只有找出破綻才能化險爲夷。 

·Meta元素： 玩家在整個遊戲進行中需結合旁白判斷自己下一步的行動。 但是，通過對碎片信息的分析及整理，玩家會漸漸改變自己的行爲及思考模式去進行遊戲並探索其中真正的劇情及核心內容。 跟隨指引，還是叛逆而爲。

一切，由你決定。你，准備好了嗎？

mo.description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.
Sometimes, the right choice is not to follow the rules.
Sometimes, the only right choice is the rules.

Consequences of Your Decisions

Watch the impact of your decisions in the journalist’s broadcast at the end of each day.
Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. 

Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App

- Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required

Real 5 Star Reviews

This Is the Police 2是廣受好評的黑色劇“This Is the Police”的續集，你可以在其中酌情解釋法律！運行警長的部門，管理你的員警，調查，審問和監禁。在這個由故事推動的冒險、戰略和回合制戰術戰鬥混合遊戲中，做出艱難的決定 - 並儘量避免自己入獄！

這是模擬？管理遊戲？戰術挑戰？視覺小說？謎題？全部都是，還不止！

深入獨一無二的故事推動體驗。
歡迎來到夏普伍德，一個寒冷而嚴酷的邊境小鎮，充滿了暴力，沒有人是完全無辜的。這個城鎮是走私者、幫派和尖叫的民粹主義者的老巢。為了維護和平與秩序，年輕的警長莉莉·裡德（莎拉·漢密爾頓）不得不與逃犯傑克·博伊德（喬恩·聖約翰）合作，並祈禱她的危險計畫不會失控。

掌管警長的部門。
你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

戰術戰鬥
發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

mo.description:
“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

《展翅翱翔》是一款屢獲殊榮的鳥類主題策略卡牌遊戲，也是一部鮮活的交互式鳥類百科，清新有趣，輕鬆愉快，適合1-5名玩家。作為鳥類發燒友，你的目標是發現和吸引更多的鳥兒加入你的自然保護區。

《展翅翱翔》（Wingspan）官方授權電子版改編，曾榮獲2019年德國年度桌面遊戲獎，權威桌遊網站BBG家庭類桌遊位列世界第一。

你們是一群鳥類發燒友——研究員、鳥類觀察家、鳥類學家和收藏家——你們一直在尋覓並試圖吸引那些最美麗的鳥類棲息到自己的野生動物保護區來。每一種鳥的加入都會讓你其中一塊棲息地上的鳥類組合變得更為豐富多彩。每一塊棲息地都各自專注於保護區生態搭建的某一重要方面。

本遊戲中，1-5名玩家在有限的回合內構建他們的自然保護區，並與其他玩家競爭。每當新的鳥類加入自然保護區，都會提升保護區在某個方面的能力，諸如鳥類產蛋、抽取新的鳥類卡牌或者收集食物。遊戲中包含170種獨特的鳥類，它們各自擁有對應它們在自然世界中所有的專長或者偏好的技能：例如，老鷹會捕獵，鵜鶘會捕魚，白鵝喜歡群居。

遊戲特色
* 輕鬆愉快的策略類卡牌遊戲，你的目標是發現和吸引最好的鳥兒。
* 同時支持單人和多人模式，最多可5名玩家組隊暢玩。
* 基於屢獲殊榮的引擎構築桌面遊戲，以卡牌為驅動，富有競爭樂趣。
* 數百隻獨特的鳥兒，配有動畫畫面和真實錄音。
* 用多種方式積攢分數，包括鳥兒、獎勵卡牌和回合目標。

tw.description:
《手機帝國》是一款以“造手機”為題材的高自由度單機模擬經營遊戲。你扮演一名回到2001年的創業者，因為獨到的眼光拿到了神秘投資人的啟動資金，進而創立了一家可能改變世界的科技企業。遊戲從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將從研發最早期的九宮格智能手機開始，一直到研發可完全獨立使用的AR智能眼鏡結束。在這35年時間裡，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程，並有機會把你的公司發展成為世界第一的科技企業。

• 有深度的玩法
《手機帝國》的核心玩法是研發更好的圖紙、升級更牛的科技、打造更強的團隊、研發更好的手機、賺取更多的利潤，如此循環。而“如何用人”是整個遊戲的精髓所在，根據員工的能力、天賦和技能，把合適的員工放到合適的崗位才會發揮出其最大潛能。員工的配合還會觸發團隊突破效果，這是一個可以讓你突破科技限制從而創造奇蹟的新機制。

• 充足的遊戲時長
《手機帝國》的遊戲內時間長達35年，將從2001年開始到2035年結束，你將親歷、見證、推動智能手機波瀾壯闊的發展歷程。

• 海量的內容
你在遊戲中可研發經典的九宮格手機、全鍵盤手機、早期觸控手機、全面屏手機、折疊屏手機，甚至未來的AR智能眼鏡，總共有超過100種手機外觀供你研究。

• 不斷進階的科技
遊戲中的電池、屏幕、材質、相機等均可不斷升級，在你資金充裕時甚至可以啟動CPU和操作系統的自研項目，你將有可能研發出性能逆天的芯片來大幅提升自己的手機品質。

• 新穎的競爭體驗
你作為科技公司的CEO將與各個時期的科技巨頭們展開競爭，你可以選擇和他們搞好關係共謀發展，也可以為爭奪優秀人才展開挖人大戰。

• 大量的隨機事件
為了增加遊戲的世界感，我們在遊戲中融入了大量的隨機事件，包括：世界事件、行業新聞、危機事件、幸運事件、員工事件、記者採訪等等，甚至還包括比如太空電梯、火星登陸、 AI大爆發等未來事件。

• 獨創的說服系統
為了更好的模擬現實生活中的人才招攬過程，我們在遊戲中內置了一款小遊戲，該遊戲以古老的“九型人格”為原型，玩家需要根據招募對象的不同人格類型，採用不同的溝通技巧和策略來說服對方。越是頂級的人才，說服的難度越高。

• 更多等待你探索的內容
遊戲中還包括信用評級、企業併購、情報系統、員工培養、公司戰略等其他好玩的元素等待你來探索。

tw.description:
[遊戲說明]

由幻刃網絡研發，心動網絡發行的《ICEY》是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，跟隨旁白的指示，你將會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，去戰鬥並發掘在遊戲中世界的真相。但其實，這也根本不是一款2D橫版動作遊戲，你也不會通過ICEY的眼睛去看，你也不會去探尋這個世界的真相。

本質上說《ICEY》是一款Meta遊戲，玩家需要通過對抗旁白的指示，思考何爲遊戲、何爲真相等等命題。在《ICEY》中，你扮演的是ICEY，而非“你自己”。當然你也可以扮演“你自己”，而非ICEY。這是一個包裹著動作遊戲外衣的陷阱。

現在，就是你發掘其真正故事的時刻。

[遊戲特色]

·高速戰鬥： 高速移動，將敵人玩弄于股掌之中。 不能遲疑，當機立斷進行攻擊、反擊或是閃避！ 這才是你的生存之道！ 

·華麗的連招系統： 操作簡單，稍微練習即可打出華麗連擊。 不同技能各有特性，靈活組合才能順利過關。 

·巨型Boss戰： 衆多超巨型Boss，充滿壓迫力的戰鬥場面。 Boss攻擊方法多樣，只有找出破綻才能化險爲夷。 

·Meta元素： 玩家在整個遊戲進行中需結合旁白判斷自己下一步的行動。 但是，通過對碎片信息的分析及整理，玩家會漸漸改變自己的行爲及思考模式去進行遊戲並探索其中真正的劇情及核心內容。 跟隨指引，還是叛逆而爲。

一切，由你決定。你，准備好了嗎？

遊戲的內容全部包含在一個神秘的立方體中，立方體的每個面都是一個獨立的世界：工廠，燈塔，遊樂園，教堂等等，他們之間看似毫不相關，實則交錯萬千，充滿了意想不到的關聯……

tw.description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.
Sometimes, the right choice is not to follow the rules.
Sometimes, the only right choice is the rules.

Consequences of Your Decisions

Watch the impact of your decisions in the journalist’s broadcast at the end of each day.
Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

tw.description:
本作品需全程連線。媚娘篇內容共十六集，女帝篇內容共三十二集，均含免費體驗章節。

您可能從沒體驗過這樣的作品——您當主角，真人互動的宮廷冒險！
《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇全新推出！誠摯邀請您踏上驚險刺激的東方宮廷權謀之旅。

● 承襲《媚娘篇》佳績，再續宮廷傳奇
《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》媚娘篇贏得了廣大用戶的喜愛。
新篇《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇，邀您提前鎖定這場驚心動魄的朝堂博弈，共同期待東方女帝傳奇的登頂新巔峰！

● 4K電影級質感，重塑東方宮廷美學
全程真人演繹、實景打造，結合4K電影級光影調度，匠心重現東方宮闕的恢弘氣象。從華服錦緞、金釵搖曳的細膩質感，到震撼人心的中國風配樂，全方位呈現極致東方古典美學。由官鴻、黃羿、姚弛、林小宅等知名演員傾情演出。更真實、更驚險刺激的體驗，更宏大的場景、更細膩的人物刻畫，讓盛世不再只存在於螢幕之中，而是於眼前真實展開。您將親身沉浸於「君臨天下」的東方美學盛宴！

● 從默默無聞的少女到傳奇女帝，您的劇本您來寫！
急欲掙脫命運的束縛？在本作品中，您將體驗最驚心動魄的宮廷權謀博弈！從默默無聞的少女，在多方勢力掣肘中突破困局，最終登上權力巔峰。感受運籌帷幄、制衡朝局的帝王智慧，這條逆天改命的稱帝之路，由您親手開創！

● 約1500分鐘真人演繹內容，沉浸體驗帝王人生
匠心打造的《媚娘篇》與《女帝篇》共約1500分鐘的實拍篇章，為您鋪展出一幅波瀾壯闊的盛世畫卷。面對詭譎多變的朝堂局勢，每一次落子、每一句對話，都將引發蝴蝶效應。高張力反轉、重重懸疑……在步步驚心中執掌乾坤，親手改寫王朝命運！
為您情有獨鍾或愛恨交織的角色應援助陣，誰能問鼎全球人氣榜首，皆由您一手掌控。

● 告別旁觀，真正體驗「朕即天下」
屏棄枯燥的點擊對話，深度互動玩法全面升級！權力不再只是一句空洞的台詞，而是您指尖真實運作的朝堂制衡

批閱奏摺：指尖輕點，趣解百態民生。面對層出不窮的新奇提案與市井趣事，看你如何妙筆生花、巧思破局，以奇招惠及萬民。

頒布聖旨：御筆輕懸，執掌群臣榮辱。看你如何恩威並施、論功行賞；透過封賞、發落與追貶，盡顯女帝知人善任的御人之道。

● 您是什麼類型的帝王？專屬人格測驗報告升級
在故事的終點，您還將獲得一份升級版專屬帝王測試報告！深度解析您的權謀風格、危機決策與馭人之道。究竟您是權情兼收、八面玲瓏的「絕命鶴頂紅」，還是至情至性、赴湯蹈火的「風月曼陀羅」，又或是心狠手辣、一心登頂的「卷王見手青」？在故事的最後，看見最真實的自己，並將您的專屬女帝圖鑑分享給全世界！

關於New One Studio

我們是專注於互動敘事的獨立團隊，致力於用創新手法融合東方文化與互動體驗。2019年，是一路同行的大家陪着《隱形守護者》走過 BAFTA 的榮光，更讓我們確信：好的互動敘事，能讓故事住進人心。這幾年，我們一頭栽進了古代盛世，醞釀了一個全新的故事。《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》，不僅為大家呈現東方權謀的「致命」美學，同時帶來考驗智謀與膽識的朝堂博弈。

兩個作品，不同的故事，同一顆初心，希望全球用戶都能在遊玩中再一次感受東方傳統文化的魅力，它將成為跨越文化的橋樑，為每一位支持全動態影像作品的用戶帶來一次全新體驗。

在《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》中，你將親自體驗一代女帝的成長之路。《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》之媚娘篇聚焦於她傳奇的起點——看她如何從默默無聞的少女，在危機四伏的宮廷中步步為營，憑智慧與膽識在險象環生的權力交鋒中存活下來。

在《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇中，你將以執棋者的姿態直面更殘酷的朝堂博弈。運籌帷幄、制衡群臣，在波譎雲詭中開創盛世，親手書寫屬於你的盛世天下！

tw.description:
Trusted by over 500,000 families. The original, best-in-class baby heart sounds app to hear baby beat at home with your iPhone. Hear My Baby uses your iPhone microphone to help you listen to baby heart sounds. HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. 

Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App

- Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required
- AI chat support provides step-by-step help with setup, positioning and recording conditions 
- Enhances low-frequency audio captured by the iPhone microphone to help users listen for and save special pregnancy sounds.
- Tailored tutorial adapts to your stage of pregnancy and setup
- Create baby sex reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to share the moment
- Record & save clips; build a personal timeline you can revisit
- Share easily with family and friends (Instagram, WhatsApp, email)
- Designed by parents with expertise in sound engineering, AI and app development; warm, honest guidance throughout
- Privacy first — you control what’s saved and shared

Real 5 Star Reviews

"I never leave reviews, let along pay for apps but let’s just say I tried this , and it def works" - Lov3r_Gurl IG (USA Sept 2025)
“I always find 'it' (sic) eventually and the rhythm is clear and strong. I love that I can record them to keep.” - T Lucker (Australia 2025)
"I downloaded this very skeptical... It took me about 45 minutes of laying down, very still, with noise canceling headphones on, but I HEARD IT. I am almost 18 weeks pregnant. From one momma to the next, it’s worth it." - Baby'sHeartbeat (2025)

“It took some time and patience... thank you for creating this cheap, awesome technology to use at home.” — Niki
“I was skeptical at first. Great app! Worth it.” — Legretta

How it works
- Hear My Baby uses your iPhone’s microphone to listen for abdominal sounds; it is not a doppler and doesn’t emit ultrasound. It’s a lifestyle keepsake for bonding and sharing, not a medical device and not for diagnosis.
- Our advanced audio engine isolates and amplifies fetal heartbeat sounds so you can listen and save the recording, and trim it to the appropriate moment for sharing quickly and easily.
- Best from around 16+ weeks; clearest for many families at ~27 weeks. Results vary with baby’s position and placenta location.

Tips for best results
- Be still, breathe lightly, and try several positions around your bump
- Press the mic firmly against the skin; explore low and to the sides
- Bluetooth/over-ear headphones can make subtle sounds easier to hear

Important
Hear My Baby is not a medical device and doesn’t replace prenatal care. If you’re concerned about anything in your pregnancy, please consult your clinician. Seek a doctor’s advice if you have any concerns. You can switch to Airplane Mode while using the app.

Privacy
Your moments are yours. You decide what to keep or delete — and who gets to hear them.

tw.description:
《Way of the Hunter》將推出手機端系列首作，太平洋西北地區的壯美景觀隨之鋪陳眼前。

在美國內茲珀斯谷的廣闊開放世界中，體驗最真實的狩獵與探索。在风景如画的自然栖息地中发现栩栩如生的动物，使用各种细节逼真的武器。

《獵人征途》的野生動物外型真實而美麗，且具備符合現實的動物群體行為特徵，提供玩家全面且真實的狩獵體驗，讓人能完全沉浸在遊戲世界。親眼目睹複雜多樣的生態環境產生的變化，周遭環境會因為你的行動而出現變動及反應。瞭解真正的獵人所代表的意義，並充分運用自己的技能來戰勝考驗。

面對人道狩獵的挑戰、搭配引人入勝的故事情節進行遊戲，或是單純地在這富饒的自然環境中自由狩獵。

* 數十種細節精緻的動物物種與真實的行為模式，為你帶來真正身歷其境的狩獵體驗
* 醒目標示動物跡象、血跡分析，以及能夠倒回觀看子彈鏡頭的射擊回顧畫面，這些功能都能讓您像專業獵人一樣狩獵
* 使用獵人感官將重要詳情和資訊醒目標示出來，或者關閉獵人感官，讓遊戲體驗更具挑戰性
* 複雜的戰利品系統，其會根據身體素質與年齡等多項因素產生獨一無二的鹿角和動物頭角
* 細膩又自然的動物動作，以及動物察覺到玩家存在時的真實反應
* 24 小時的日夜循環，再加上風和天氣的變化
* 真實彈道與子彈物理模擬
* 大量槍枝和裝備選擇，其中包含證照管制裝備，例如：Bushnell、Federal、Leupold、Primos、Remington 和 Steyr Arms
* 遊戲內的經營模式讓玩家可以獵取野味之後，將販賣肉品所得的資金用於購買新裝備、狩獵通行證以及戰利品狩獵台上的標本
* 引人入勝的故事情節，訴說著一段關於家族狩獵事業的掙扎糾葛，以及圍繞其間的競爭關係和友誼
* 直觀的相片模式，讓你可以捕捉並分享自己最愛的瞬間
* 使用手柄或觸控控制追蹤獵物
* 優化手機端操控，兼顧舒適與效率

This Is the Police 2是廣受好評的黑色劇“This Is the Police”的續集，你可以在其中酌情解釋法律！運行警長的部門，管理你的員警，調查，審問和監禁。在這個由故事推動的冒險、戰略和回合制戰術戰鬥混合遊戲中，做出艱難的決定 - 並儘量避免自己入獄！

這是模擬？管理遊戲？戰術挑戰？視覺小說？謎題？全部都是，還不止！

深入獨一無二的故事推動體驗。
歡迎來到夏普伍德，一個寒冷而嚴酷的邊境小鎮，充滿了暴力，沒有人是完全無辜的。這個城鎮是走私者、幫派和尖叫的民粹主義者的老巢。為了維護和平與秩序，年輕的警長莉莉·裡德（莎拉·漢密爾頓）不得不與逃犯傑克·博伊德（喬恩·聖約翰）合作，並祈禱她的危險計畫不會失控。

掌管警長的部門。
你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

這不是普通的雙搖杆射擊遊戲。這款遊戲強調戰術戰鬥和秘密行動，而不只是開槍射擊，而且還有精彩劇情！ 

戰術戰鬥
發揮環境優勢。透過掩護躲避攻擊。側擊敵人可提高效果，但自己要防止側擊！運用交易的工具創造優勢 — 碎片榴彈、閃光彈、無人機、炮塔、近距離地雷等...

tw.description:
“An amazingly animated iOS game.” – Time Magazine

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

•	Tactical top-down shooter

us.description:
Scan locally for nearby smart-glasses Bluetooth signals and get a clear alert when a likely device is close.

AntiZuck uses your device to show active signals that may come from smart glasses, including Ray-Ban Meta, Snap Spectacles, Amazon Echo Frames, and RayNeo. It also shows repeat sightings, confidence, and rough proximity.

FEATURES

• Live signal field: likely glasses appear as blips with rough proximity and confidence
• Local alerts when a likely device starts broadcasting — even when the app is closed, when iOS permits background scanning
• Sightings history: repeat encounters, confidence, distance, and why each signal was flagged
• Add familiar glasses to Your Circle with custom labels, optional relationships, and per-device alert controls
• Show rough proximity in feet or meters
• Snooze alerts for an hour or the evening, right from the notification
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the latest status and a pause button
• Control Center toggle to pause or resume scanning, assignable to the Action Button
• No account, no ads, completely local and private

Privacy stays local. The app does not identify people, record audio or video, track location, or upload signal history. Detection is best-effort and depends on what nearby devices advertise over Bluetooth. Smart glasses mostly broadcast at power-on, pairing, and case-open, so coverage is opportunistic.

Mobile Empire is a simulation game based on "manufacturing mobile phones", with a high degree of freedom. You will play as an entrepreneur back in 2001. FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

FEATURES

• Live signal field: likely glasses appear as blips with rough proximity and confidence
• Local alerts when a likely device starts broadcasting — even when the app is closed, when iOS permits background scanning
• Sightings history: repeat encounters, confidence, distance, and why each signal was flagged
• Add familiar glasses to Your Circle with custom labels, optional relationships, and per-device alert controls

us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Scan locally for nearby smart-glasses Bluetooth signals and get a clear alert when a likely device is close.

AntiZuck uses your device to show active signals that may come from smart glasses, including Ray-Ban Meta, Snap Spectacles, Amazon Echo Frames, and RayNeo. It also shows repeat sightings, confidence, and rough proximity.

FEATURES

• Live signal field: likely glasses appear as blips with rough proximity and confidence
• Local alerts when a likely device starts broadcasting — even when the app is closed, when iOS permits background scanning
• Sightings history: repeat encounters, confidence, distance, and why each signal was flagged
• Add familiar glasses to Your Circle with custom labels, optional relationships, and per-device alert controls
• Show rough proximity in feet or meters
• Snooze alerts for an hour or the evening, right from the notification
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with the latest status and a pause button
• Control Center toggle to pause or resume scanning, assignable to the Action Button
• No account, no ads, completely local and private

Privacy stays local. The app does not identify people, record audio or video, track location, or upload signal history. Detection is best-effort and depends on what nearby devices advertise over Bluetooth. Smart glasses mostly broadcast at power-on, pairing, and case-open, so coverage is opportunistic.

Mobile Empire is a simulation game based on "manufacturing mobile phones", with a high degree of freedom. You will play as an entrepreneur back in 2001. You acquired the initial capital from a mystery investor because of your unique vision and created a technological enterprise that may change the world. The game starts from 2001 and ends in 2035, during which you will start with old school smartphones in the early R&D stages, progressing until AR smart glasses can be independently used. You have the chance to develop your company into the world's number one technological enterprise.

Currently, Mobile Empire is probably the only PC simulation game based on "manufacturing mobile phones". You will have the chance to create miracles and develop your little-known company into a global technological empire.

FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more!

Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience.
Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control.

Take charge of the Sheriff’s department.
Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department.

Engage in tactical combat.
During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life.

Become a true detective.
Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought.

Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’!

tr.description:
Trusted by over 500,000 families. The original, best-in-class baby heart sounds app to hear baby beat at home with your iPhone. Hear My Baby uses your iPhone microphone to help you listen to baby heart sounds. HMB 2.0 adds AI chat support, tailored tutorials, and pregnancy reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to help you get results faster, and is now free to download. 

Why parents choose Hear My Baby Heartbeat App

- Hear your baby’s heartbeat using the iPhone’s built-in microphone — no accessories required
- AI chat support provides step-by-step help with setup, positioning and recording conditions 
- Enhances low-frequency audio captured by the iPhone microphone to help users listen for and save special pregnancy sounds.
- Tailored tutorial adapts to your stage of pregnancy and setup
- Create baby sex reveal videos (+ your heartbeat) to share the moment
- Record & save clips; build a personal timeline you can revisit
- Share easily with family and friends (Instagram, WhatsApp, email)
- Designed by parents with expertise in sound engineering, AI and app development; warm, honest guidance throughout
- Privacy first — you control what’s saved and shared

Real 5 Star Reviews

"I never leave reviews, let along pay for apps but let’s just say I tried this , and it def works" - Lov3r_Gurl IG (USA Sept 2025)
“I always find 'it' (sic) eventually and the rhythm is clear and strong. I love that I can record them to keep.” - T Lucker (Australia 2025)
"I downloaded this very skeptical... It took me about 45 minutes of laying down, very still, with noise canceling headphones on, but I HEARD IT. I am almost 18 weeks pregnant. From one momma to the next, it’s worth it." - Baby'sHeartbeat (2025)

“It took some time and patience... thank you for creating this cheap, awesome technology to use at home.” — Niki
“I was skeptical at first. Great app! Worth it.” — Legretta

How it works
- Hear My Baby uses your iPhone’s microphone to listen for abdominal sounds; it is not a doppler and doesn’t emit ultrasound. It’s a lifestyle keepsake for bonding and sharing, not a medical device and not for diagnosis.
- Our advanced audio engine isolates and amplifies fetal heartbeat sounds so you can listen and save the recording, and trim it to the appropriate moment for sharing quickly and easily.
- Best from around 16+ weeks; clearest for many families at ~27 weeks. Results vary with baby’s position and placenta location.

Tips for best results
- Be still, breathe lightly, and try several positions around your bump
- Press the mic firmly against the skin; explore low and to the sides
- Bluetooth/over-ear headphones can make subtle sounds easier to hear

Important
Hear My Baby is not a medical device and doesn’t replace prenatal care. If you’re concerned about anything in your pregnancy, please consult your clinician. Seek a doctor’s advice if you have any concerns. You can switch to Airplane Mode while using the app.

Privacy
Your moments are yours. You decide what to keep or delete — and who gets to hear them.

- Length: weekly, yearly

Kendi halı sahanı yönetebilir misin?

Küçük bir saha kiralayarak başla. Rezervasyonları takip et, müşterilere uygun saatleri ayarla ve gün içinde gelen fırsatları kaçırma.

Sadece saha kiralamakla kalma; kafeteryadan çay, tost ve su sat, krampon, hakem ve farklı hizmetlerle işletmeni büyüt. Maçlar sırasında bazen beklenmedik olaylar yaşanabilir. Kavga çıkabilir, ürünler bozulabilir ya da müşteriler senden farklı isteklerde bulunabilir.

Gün sonunda kazancını hesapla, masraflarını öde ve halı sahanı geliştir.

Otoparkçı’da küçük bir otoparkın başına geçiyorsun. İlk başta sadece birkaç park yerin var; ama doğru kararlarla kazancını artırıp otoparkını adım adım büyütebilirsin.

Araçları uygun park alanlarına al, süreleri dolduğunda paranı topla ve müşteri memnuniyetini dengede tut. Hava durumu, gün içindeki yoğunluk ve verdiğin kararlar kazancını doğrudan etkiler. Bazen işler sakin gider, bazen de otopark bir anda dolup taşar.

Yeni park yerleri aç, kapasiteni artır, gerektiğinde ek vardiya çağırarak işleri hızlandır. Her gün daha fazla kazanmak için fiyat, memnuniyet ve yoğunluk dengesini iyi kurman gerekir.

Basit görünen ama doğru hamlelerle büyüyen bir otopark işletmeye hazır mısın?

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter

Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide
- 300+ collectible monsters to capture, train, and evolve.
- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

Join the adventure today and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate monster trainer in EvoCreo 2! Can you catch them all and master the secrets of the Creo?

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. 

You are bird enthusiasts—researchers, bird watchers, ornithologists, and collectors—seeking to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. Each bird extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your habitats. Each habitat focuses on a key aspect of the growth of your preserves.

In Wingspan up to 5 players compete to build up their nature preserves in a limited number of turns. Each beautiful bird that you add to your preserve makes you better at laying eggs, drawing cards, or gathering food. Many of the 170 unique birds have powers that echo real life: your hawks will hunt, your pelicans will fish, and your geese will form a flock.

Features
- Relaxing strategy card game where your goal is to discover and attract the best birds.
- Single player and multiplayer modes for up to five players.
- Based on award winning, competitive, card-driven, engine-building board game.
- Hundreds of unique, animated birds with their real life sound recordings.
- Multiple ways to accumulate points with birds, bonus cards and end-of-round goals.

《手机帝国》是一款以“造手机”为题材的高自由度单机模拟经营游戏。你扮演一名回到2001年的创业者，因为独到的眼光拿到了神秘投资人的启动资金，进而创立了一家可能改变世界的科技企业。游戏从2001年开始到2035年结束，你将从研发最早期的九宫格智能手机开始，一直到研发可完全独立使用的AR智能眼镜结束。在这35年时间里，你将亲历、见证、推动智能手机波澜壮阔的发展历程，并有机会把你的公司发展成为世界第一的科技企业。

•有深度的玩法
《手机帝国》的核心玩法是研发更好的图纸、升级更牛的科技、打造更强的团队、研发更好的手机、赚取更多的利润，如此循环。而“如何用人”是整个游戏的精髓所在，根据员工的能力、天赋和技能，把合适的员工放到合适的岗位才会发挥出其最大潜能。员工的配合还会触发团队突破效果，这是一个可以让你突破科技限制从而创造奇迹的新机制。

•海量的内容
你在游戏中可研发经典的九宫格手机、全键盘手机、早期触控手机、全面屏手机、折叠屏手机，甚至未来的AR智能眼镜，总共有超过100种手机外观供你研究。

•不断进阶的科技
游戏中的电池、屏幕、材质、相机等均可不断升级，在你资金充裕时甚至可以启动CPU和操作系统的自研项目，你将有可能研发出性能逆天的芯片来大幅提升自己的手机品质。

•新颖的竞争体验
你作为科技公司的CEO将与各个时期的科技巨头们展开竞争，你可以选择和他们搞好关系共谋发展，也可以为争夺优秀人才展开挖人大战。

•大量的随机事件
为了增加游戏的世界感，我们在游戏中融入了大量的随机事件，包括：世界事件、行业新闻、危机事件、幸运事件、员工事件、记者采访等等，甚至还包括比如太空电梯、火星登陆、AI大爆发等未来事件。

•独创的说服系统
为了更好的模拟现实生活中的人才招揽过程，我们在游戏中内置了一款小游戏，该游戏以古老的“九型人格”为原型，玩家需要根据招募对象的不同人格类型，采用不同的沟通技巧和策略来说服对方。越是顶级的人才，说服的难度越高。

•更多等待你探索的内容
游戏中还包括信用评级、企业并购、情报系统、员工培养、公司战略等其他好玩的元素等待你来探索。

ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action game. As you follow the narrator's omnipresent voice, you will see through ICEY's eyes and learn the truth about her world. 

“Alright, you caught me! This ISN'T really just a simple 2D action game, and you WON'T be seeing through ICEY's eyes... NOR will you learn the truth about her world." says the narrator.

In fact, you can become ICEY, and let loose the shackles of your own identity. You are ICEY, and ICEY is you... if you want it that way. Feel free to keep hold of your own self, if you wish.

pt.description:
Moncage is a stunning vignette puzzle adventure developed by Optillusion. 

The game takes place inside a mysterious cube, with each side of the cube housing a unique world: be it an old factory, a light tower, an amusement park, or a church, etc. At first sight, they may seem random and unrelated, but upon closer look, you will become mesmerized by the subtle and intricate ways of how these worlds connect…  

【Solve Puzzles with Mind-Boggling Optical Illusions】
Use your imagination and spare no brain cells to find the connection and pinpoint every possible interaction between different sides of the cube, then watch as the magic unfold in front of you.

【Collect All Photos to Unveil the Story】
Behind the puzzles, there lies a story with a surprising twist for the player to uncover. Collect the photos from obscure corners and angles to reveal the underlying story, one photo at a time.

【Get Unstuck with Thoughtful Hints】
There is a multitude of guidance systems to help prevent players from getting stuck. Focus can be activated to highlight the key items to the solution, while hint texts are available to provide further clarity. And, if all else fails, video walkthroughs can be unlocked as the ultimate safety plan.

FileFlip is the fastest way to convert a file on your iPhone: choose any file, and FileFlip detects what it is and shows you every format it can become. Pick one from the dropdown, tap Convert, and share or save the result. That's the whole app.

WHAT IT CONVERTS
— Images: PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP and WebP → PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF or PDF
— PDFs → crisp page images (PNG or JPEG) or extracted plain text
— Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC → M4A, WAV, AIFF or CAF
— Video: MOV, MP4, M4V → MP4, MOV or audio-only M4A
— Documents: TXT, Markdown, RTF, HTML → polished PDF, TXT, RTF or HTML
— Data: CSV ↔ JSON, both directions

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every conversion runs 100% on your device using Apple's own frameworks. Your files are never uploaded anywhere — FileFlip makes no network connections at all. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription.

BUILT-IN HISTORY
Everything you convert is kept in the History tab for one-tap re-sharing, and also appears in the Files app under On My iPhone › FileFlip, so your converted files are always yours.

Multi-page PDFs export every page as its own image. HEIC photos become shareable JPEGs in two taps. Voice memos become WAVs for editing. Camera clips become MP4s that play anywhere.

— Pay once. Own it forever.
— 100% offline. Your files never leave your phone.

pt.description:
Border Officer – A Document, Control, and Security Game

Every day is a new day at the border.
Every day, new faces arrive.
Behind every face lies a story, a dream… or a threat.

Border Officer puts you at the center of the toughest decisions as a border officer in a document control and security game.
You must act according to rules, documents, and presidential orders; the cost of a small mistake can be paid by the entire country.

Your Mission
	•	Inspect the documents of incoming characters
	•	Examine stamps and detect forged documents
	•	Scan bags using X-ray screening and find illegal items
	•	Identify and capture wanted criminals
	•	Earn money by making the right decisions

Scanning, Searching, and Security

Not every bag is innocent.
Not every document is valid.

Protect the border using scanning and search systems. Maintain security—but do not reject the innocent.
Sometimes, the right choice is not to follow the rules.
Sometimes, the only right choice is the rules.

Consequences of Your Decisions

Watch the impact of your decisions in the journalist’s broadcast at the end of each day.
Some choices satisfy the public; others push the country toward chaos.

The border is yours. The decision is yours. The consequences are ours.

pt.description:
Aproveite a primeira entrada da série móvel Way of the Hunter, ambientada no belo noroeste do Pacífico norte-americano.

Esta experiência de caça autêntica deixa você caçar e explorar ambientes abertos enormes nos Nez Perce Valleys dos Estados Unidos. Encontre animais realistas em belos habitats naturais e utilize diversas réplicas detalhadas de armas.

Way of the Hunter oferece uma experiência altamente imersiva e integrada, com vida selvagem deslumbrante e comportamento realista dos grupos de animais. Testemunhe as transformações em ecossistemas complexos, que reagem e se adaptam ao que você fizer. Aprenda a caçar de verdade e ponha suas habilidades à prova.

Enfrente os desafios da caça ética com uma história cativante, ou simplesmente divirta-se caçando em ambientes deslumbrantes.

* Dezenas de espécies incrivelmente detalhadas com comportamentos realistas para proporcionar uma experiência de caça verdadeiramente imersiva.
* Cace como um profissional com recursos que destacam sinais de animais e analisam respingos de sangue. Analise a trajetória dos seus disparos com a câmera rebobinável.
* Use seu sentido de caçador para destacar detalhes e informações importantes, ou desative-o.
* O complexo sistema de troféus gera chifres exclusivos com base em vários fatores, como estado físico e idade das caças.
* Animações e reações de animais naturais e sofisticadas ao sentir a presença dos jogadores.
* Ciclos de dia e noite com 24 horas, além de vento e clima variáveis.
* Simulação realística de balística e de física de projéteis.
* Grande seleção de armas de fogo e equipamentos, incluindo itens licenciados das empresas Bushnell, Federal, Leupold, Primos, Remington e Steyr Arms.
* A economia do jogo permite a você caçar e vender a carne para comprar mais equipamentos, licenças de caça e serviços de taxidermia para seus troféus.
* Uma história cativante sobre os obstáculos enfrentados por uma empresa familiar de caça e a rivalidade e amizades que a cercam.
* Modo de fotografia intuitivo, para capturar e compartilhar seus momentos favoritos.
* Rastreie a sua presa usando ou o gamepad ou os controles de toque
* Controle otimizado e eficiente para dispositivos móveis

Interpreta a lei como entenderes em This is the Police 2, a sequela do aclamado drama noir "This Is the Police!". Administra a esquadra do xerife, gere os teus agentes, investiga, interroga e prende. Toma decisões difíceis - e tenta permanecer fora da prisão! - nesta mistura de aventura, estratégia e combate tático por turnos.

É uma simulação? Um jogo de gestão? Um desafio tático? Um romance visual? Um enigma? É tudo isto e muito mais!

Envolve-te numa experiência única guiada pela história.
Bem-vindo a Sharpwood. Uma cidade fronteiriça fria e agreste dilacerada pela violência, onde ninguém é completamente inocente. Contrabandistas, gangues e populistas radicais  dizem que esta cidade é a sua casa. Para manter a paz e a ordem, a jovem xerife Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) terá que se juntar ao criminoso fugitivo Jack Boyd (Jon St. John) e rezar para que o seu perigoso plano não se descontrole.

Assume o comando da esquadra do xerife.
Os teus subordinados não são uns meros recursos; são pessoas comuns com as suas próprias forças, fraquezas, medos e preconceitos - e terás que contar com todos para sobreviveres. Alguém anda a beber demais? Ou arranja sempre desculpas para faltar ao trabalho? Ou recusa-se a cumprir ordens? Terás que mostrar mão firme se quiseres impor disciplina nesta esquadra.

Envolve-te em combate tático.
Durante as tuas operações mais perigosas, o jogo muda para o combate por turnos. Reúne uma equipa com os teus melhores agentes. Estuda cuidadosamente o terreno, ajusta os teus planos, aproxima-te furtivamente dos teus suspeitos e usa armas e equipamentos não letais - se a situação permitir. Mas como nem sempre é possível evitar os tiroteios tem cuidado: "This Is the Police 2" não tem pontos de vida. Uma simples bala pode custar a vida a um polícia.

Sê um verdadeiro detetive.
Recolhe indícios, estuda provas, interroga suspeitos e manda os criminosos para tribunal. E se o suspeito era inocente? Talvez esteja na hora de descobrir se algum juiz de Sharpwood pode ser comprado.

A Lenda do Grande Herói é um novo RPG de mundo aberto desenvolvido pelo estúdio Half Amateur Studio, ambientado no mundo das artes marciais. É um jogo de sobrevivência pixelado no estilo wuxia. Você assumirá o papel de um novato, explorando o mundo das artes marciais, enfrentando desafios e construindo sua jornada para tornar-se um grande herói.

Hear My Baby recebeu uma grande atualização.

O app agora é gratuito para baixar para novos usuários, com teste grátis e opções de assinatura após o teste.

Se você já comprou o Hear My Baby como app pago, obrigado — seu acesso está protegido. Você não precisará pagar novamente e poderá manter todas as suas gravações para sempre.

Esta atualização também inclui:

• Dicas de escuta guiadas por IA para ajudar você a ter a melhor chance de ouvir os sons dos batimentos do bebê
• Uma experiência de onboarding mais clara e tranquila
• Orientações melhoradas sobre quando e como usar o app
• Recursos adicionais para gravar, salvar e compartilhar
• Melhorias gerais de desempenho e correções de bugs

Hear My Baby foi criado para conexão, escuta e criação de memórias. Não é um dispositivo médico, monitor fetal, Doppler ou ultrassom Doppler.
pt.description:
Escolhido por mais de 500.000 famílias. O app original e best-in-class para ouvir em casa os batimentos do seu bebé com o iPhone. Hear My Baby usa o microfone do iPhone para ajudar você a ouvir os sons dos batimentos do bebé. O HMB 2.0 adiciona chat com IA, tutoriais personalizados e vídeos de revelação do sexo do bebé (+ os seus batimentos), ajudando você a obter resultados mais rapidamente. Agora é grátis para baixar.

POR QUE OS PAIS ESCOLHEM HEAR MY BABY

• Ouça os batimentos do seu bebé usando o microfone integrado do iPhone — sem acessórios
• Chat com IA com ajuda passo a passo para configuração, posicionamento e condições de gravação
• Melhora o áudio de baixa frequência captado pelo iPhone para ajudar você a ouvir e guardar sons especiais da gravidez
• Tutorial personalizado de acordo com a fase da gravidez e a configuração
• Crie vídeos para revelar o sexo do bebé (+ os seus batimentos)
• Grave e guarde clipes; crie uma linha do tempo pessoal
• Partilhe facilmente com família e amigos pelo Instagram, WhatsApp e email
• Criado por pais com experiência em engenharia de som, IA e desenvolvimento de apps
• Privacidade em primeiro lugar — você controla o que é guardado e partilhado

AVALIAÇÕES REAIS DE 5 ESTRELAS

“Eu nunca deixo avaliações, muito menos pago por apps, mas experimentei este e realmente funciona.” — Lov3r_Gurl IG (EUA, setembro de 2025)

“Acabo sempre por encontrá-lo e o ritmo é claro e forte. Adoro poder gravar os batimentos e guardá-los.” — T Lucker (Austrália, 2025)

“Baixei muito cética... levei cerca de 45 minutos deitada, completamente imóvel, com auscultadores com cancelamento de ruído, mas EU OUVI. Estou com quase 18 semanas. De uma mãe para outra, vale a pena.” — Baby'sHeartbeat (2025)

COMO FUNCIONA

Hear My Baby usa o microfone do iPhone para ouvir sons abdominais; não é um Doppler e não emite ultrassom. É um app de estilo de vida para criar recordações, promover a ligação com o bebé e partilhar momentos, não é um dispositivo médico e não se destina a diagnóstico.

O nosso avançado motor de áudio isola e amplifica os sons dos batimentos cardíacos fetais para que você possa ouvi-los, guardar a gravação e recortá-la no momento certo para partilhar de forma rápida e fácil.

Funciona melhor a partir de cerca de 16+ semanas; para muitas famílias, os sons são mais claros por volta das 27 semanas. Os resultados variam conforme a posição do bebé e da placenta.

DICAS PARA MELHORES RESULTADOS

• Fique imóvel, respire suavemente e experimente várias posições na barriga
• Pressione o microfone firmemente contra a pele; experimente mais abaixo e nas laterais
• Auscultadores Bluetooth/over-ear podem facilitar a audição de sons mais subtis

IMPORTANTE

Hear My Baby não é um dispositivo médico e não substitui os cuidados pré-natais. Se tiver qualquer preocupação durante a gravidez, consulte o seu médico. Procure aconselhamento médico se tiver alguma preocupação. Você pode ativar o Modo Avião enquanto usa o app.

PRIVACIDADE

Os seus momentos pertencem a você. Você decide o que guardar ou eliminar — e quem pode ouvi-los.

ASSINATURAS

Assine para ter acesso aos recursos Premium do app.

• Duração: semanal, anual
• O pagamento será cobrado na sua conta iTunes assim que confirmar a compra
• Você pode gerir as suas assinaturas e desativar a renovação automática nas Definições da conta
• A assinatura será renovada automaticamente, a menos que a renovação automática seja desativada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período atual
• O custo da renovação será cobrado na sua conta nas 24 horas anteriores ao fim do período atual
• Ao cancelar, a assinatura permanecerá ativa até ao fim do período. A renovação automática será desativada, mas o período atual não será reembolsado
• Qualquer parte não utilizada de um período de teste gratuito, se oferecido, será perdida ao comprar uma assinatura

pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

pt.description:
Uma aventura de ficção científica no velho oeste espacial continua em Space Marshals 2. Este jogo de tiro tático com visão isométrica coloca o jogador na pele do especialista Burton, na luta contra os elementos criminosos da galáxia. 

Este não é um jogo de tiros qualquer. Há ênfase no combate tático com subterfúgio, além dos tiroteios. Sem contar a história! 

COMBATE TÁTICO
Use a ambientação a seu favor. Evite ataques usando coberturas. Flanqueie inimigos e evite ser flanqueado! Use as ferramentas certas para ganhar vantagens: bombas de fumaça, granadas de luz, torres de defesa, minas de proximidade e muito mais...

SUBTERFÚGIO
Escolha sua aproximação cautelosamente. Alguns dizem que entrar em combate direto, com as armas na mão, não é a melhor alternativa. Use distrações para separar inimigos. Use nocautes de subterfúgio e armas silenciosas para reduzir os números dos oponentes. Invada torres de defesa e vire-as contra seus mestres. Atraia facções diferentes para o mesmo lugar e faça-as lutar entre si.

EQUIPAMENTO E PREPARAÇÃO
Escolher seu equipamento faz parte da tática. Além da armadura e das granadas, é possível carregar uma arma de duas mãos e uma arma de uma mão. Tem para todos os gostos. Espingardas, pistolas, fuzis de assalto, fuzis de precisão, balestras, armas de energia, machados de arremesso e muito mais.
• Jogo de tiro tático com visão isométrica
• Gráficos em HD belíssimos e com estilo próprio

“Really can't get enough of Space Marshals.” – Touch Arcade

”Space Marshals just screams “PLAY ME!” – 148 Apps


ABOUT THE GAME
Space Marshals is a Sci-fi Wild West adventure taking place in outer space! This tactical top-down shooter puts you in the shoes of specialist Burton in his hunt for dangerous fugitives after a disastrous prison break.

TACTICAL COMBAT
Use the environment to your advantage. Avoid attacks by taking cover. Flank enemies for extra efficiency, but avoid getting flanked yourself! Use the tools of the trade to gain an edge - frag grenades, flash bangs, distractions, personal shields, proximity mines and more.

STEALTH
Choose your approach with care. Some say running into the fray guns blazing isn’t always the best option. Use distractions to single out opponents. Use disguises and covers to sneak past irrelevant guards. Use silenced weapons to covertly reduce the enemy numbers.

LOAD-OUTS & GEAR
Choosing your load-out is a big part of your tactics. In addition to body armor and grenades you can carry one two-handed and one single-handed weapon in each mission - and there’s something for everyone. Shotguns, handguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, crossbows, energy weapons, throwing axes and more.

### IMPORTANT ### Please note that iPhone 4 is not supported.

•	Tactical top-down shooter

Wingspan é um premiado jogo de cartas de estratégia relaxante sobre pássaros para 1 a 5 jogadores. Cada pássaro que você joga estende uma cadeia de combinações poderosas em um de seus três habitats.

A adaptação digital oficialmente licenciada de Wingspan, vencedora do prestigioso prêmio de jogo de tabuleiro Kennerspiel des Jahres 2019.

Vocês são entusiastas de pássaros — pesquisadores, observadores de pássaros, ornitólogos e colecionadores — procurando descobrir e atrair os melhores pássaros para sua rede de reservas de vida selvagem. Cada pássaro expande uma cadeia de combinações poderosas em um de seus habitats. Cada habitat se concentra em um aspecto fundamental do crescimento de suas reservas.

Em Wingspan, até 5 jogadores competem para construir suas reservas naturais em um número limitado de turnos. Cada pássaro lindo que você adiciona à sua reserva melhora sua capacidade de colocar ovos, tirar cartas ou colher alimentos. Muitos dos 170 pássaros únicos têm poderes que refletem na vida real: seus falcões caçam, seus pelicanos pescam e seus gansos formam um bando.

Características
- Jogo de cartas de estratégia relaxante, onde seu objetivo é descobrir e atrair os melhores pássaros.
- Modos solo e multijogador para até cinco jogadores.
- Com base no premiado e competitivo jogo de tabuleiro baseado em cartas e construção motores.
- Centenas de pássaros animados e únicos, com gravações de seus cantos reais.
- Diversas maneiras de acumular pontos com pássaros, cartas de bônus e objetivos de final de rodada.

pt.description:
MagicKit AI – Kit de Ferramentas Tudo-em-Um para o Seu Dispositivo

O MagicKit AI é um aplicativo utilitário completo, projetado para ajudá-lo a monitorar seu dispositivo, otimizar o desempenho e acessar ferramentas do dia a dia em uma interface prática. Desenvolvido especialmente para iOS, o MagicKit AI reúne funcionalidades essenciais enquanto protege sua privacidade e economiza bateria.

Ferramentas do Dispositivo e do Sistema
	•	Status da Bateria: Veja o nível de carga e o estado atual da bateria
	•	Uso de Armazenamento: Analise o espaço usado e disponível
	•	Informações do Dispositivo: Verifique detalhes do hardware e do sistema
	•	Tempo de Atividade: Monitore há quanto tempo o dispositivo está ligado
	•	Dicas de Bateria: Receba conselhos úteis para melhorar o uso da bateria
	•	Limpeza de Fotos: Detecte e remova fotos duplicadas ou semelhantes
	•	Limpeza de Contatos: Organize contatos removendo duplicatas e entradas incompletas
	•	Gerenciador de RAM: Monitore o uso da memória e otimize o desempenho
	•	Teste de Benchmark: Avalie o desempenho de CPU, GPU, memória e rede

Ferramentas de Rede
	•	Teste de Velocidade: Meça a velocidade da conexão com a internet
	•	Informações do Wi-Fi: Veja nome da rede, IP e status da conexão
	•	Consulta de IP: Verifique a geolocalização de endereços IP públicos
	•	Informações de Localização: Acompanhe GPS, velocidade, direção e altitude

Segurança e Privacidade
	•	Gerador de Senhas: Crie senhas fortes e seguras com opções personalizáveis
	•	Gerador de Frases de Acesso: Crie frases memoráveis e seguras
	•	Gerador de UUID: Crie identificadores únicos em vários formatos
	•	Gerador de PIN Seguro: Gere códigos PIN seguros com várias opções
	•	E-mail Temporário: Crie e-mails descartáveis para proteger sua privacidade

Ferramentas Utilitárias
	•	Conversor de Unidades: Converta entre diferentes unidades de medida
	•	Conversor de Moeda e Cripto: Veja taxas de câmbio em tempo real para moedas e criptomoedas
	•	Calculadora de Datas: Calcule diferenças entre datas com suporte para dias úteis
	•	Conversor de Fuso Horário: Converta horários com atualizações ao vivo e suporte a horário de verão
	•	Contagem Regressiva e Lembretes: Crie contagens regressivas personalizadas com lembretes e eventos recorrentes
	•	Contador Mágico: Acompanhe múltiplos contadores com estatísticas e sequências
	•	Leitor de QR Code: Escaneie códigos QR instantaneamente
	•	Scanner de Documentos e Cartões: Capture e salve digitalizações com reconhecimento de texto via IA
	•	Bússola e Nível: Meça direção e nível usando os sensores do dispositivo
	•	Travar Orientação: Trave a orientação da tela ao usar o app
	•	Medidor de Áudio: Meça níveis de som ao redor com o microfone
	•	Gerenciador de Área de Transferência: Acesse e gerencie textos copiados durante a sessão
	•	Lanterna e Brilho: Ative a lanterna e ajuste o brilho da tela
	•	Bloco de Notas: Crie, organize e gerencie notas com categorias e backup no iCloud
	•	Gerador Universal: Gere dados aleatórios como texto, números, datas e mais

Destaques
	•	Interface limpa e fácil de usar com ferramentas assistidas
	•	Seção de Ferramentas em Destaque com as mais populares
	•	Sem anúncios ou compras no aplicativo
	•	Leve e eficiente no uso de bateria
	•	Compatível com todos os dispositivos iOS
	•	Atualizações frequentes com novas ferramentas
	•	Desenvolvido com foco em privacidade e desempenho
	•	Suporte para tema claro/escuro com animações suaves

Perfeito para:
	•	Monitorar e otimizar o dispositivo
	•	Medições e conversões do dia a dia
	•	Escanear documentos e QR Codes
	•	Limpar fotos e contatos duplicados
	•	Criar lembretes e contagens regressivas
	•	Acompanhar hábitos e progresso
	•	Acessar ferramentas rápidas como lanterna e brilho
	•	Diagnósticos básicos de rede
	•	Criar senhas seguras e manter a privacidade
	•	Tomar notas rápidas e organizadas

Baixe o MagicKit AI hoje mesmo e simplifique suas tarefas diárias com um kit inteligente e poderoso.
